rules: No target execution until all pins and independent controls are admitted
Private raw streams retained separately from reviewed publishable summaries
Failed, timed-out, truncated or partial captures never become EMPTY or OBSERVED
No raw identities, paths, process arguments, environment, credentials or provider error text in public reports
No credentials or private signing keys in package or target evidence
No remote providers, DB connections, service changes, ACL/firewall changes, installations or native worker execution
STOP on unknown owner, protected target, unexpected IO/network/process/write, secret exposure or bound failure
No automatic deletion; preserve failed captures and nonce/replay history
